segments.label: Stealing the Core
segments.description: An elderly man stealthily removes a glowing green core from a device and hands it to a robot. The scene is tense but relatively calm.

segments.label: Violent Confrontation
segments.description: A robot attacks the man. The man fights back using a wrench and spray paint, eventually destroying the robot in a violent struggle. The scene is chaotic, loud, and action-packed.

candidateBreaks.label: Mid-Fight
reasons: Narrative continuity is critical during the fight.
Interruption would severely damage viewer experience.

candidateBreaks.label: Post-Fight Recovery
reasons: The fight has just ended, but the scene is still chaotic with fire and debris.
The protagonist is recovering from the struggle.
Narrative closure is not yet complete.

limitations: No clear low-intensity boundary exists within the 45-85s window; the entire segment is high-intensity action.
The nominal opportunity at 45s falls directly into the peak of the physical conflict.
